text: Tourism ensures the survival of remote communities. To what extent is this true in your
country? [30]

with this statement? [30]

statement? [30]

statement. [30]
Visual forms of art express emotions in ways that written words cannot achieve. Discuss. [30]
The biggest concern about climate change is the threat that it creates for the people of the world.
To what extent do you agree with this view? [30]
Songs have the power to divide as well as unite people. Discuss. [30]
